description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs: TrustAnchor's own signature is explicitly not verified in chain_walk. RFC 5280 §6.1.1(c) states the trust anchor is trusted by definition. The comment in TrustAnchor's doc explains this clearly. A contributor might suggest adding signature verification to 'make things more secure' — this would be both incorrect (the anchor has no issuer to verify against) and potentially harmful (self-signed cert verification provides a false sense of security, as anyone can create a self-signed cert). The design is correct.
title: Trust anchor not signature-verified by design (RFC 5280 §6.1.1(c))
